# bitbucket_workspace_pipeline_variable (Resource)

A workspace-level Bitbucket Pipelines variable, shared across every repository in the workspace. When secured = true, Bitbucket never returns the value again after creation, so Terraform trusts the value in your configuration/state instead.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "bitbucket_workspace_pipeline_variable" "shared_registry" {
  key     = "DOCKER_REGISTRY"
  value   = "registry.example.internal"
  secured = false
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `key` (String) Variable name, as used in bitbucket-pipelines.yml.
- `value` (String, Sensitive) Variable value.

### Optional

- `secured` (Boolean) If true, Bitbucket hides the value from logs and the API after creation.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Identifier, formatted as "workspace/variable_uuid".
- `variable_uuid` (String) Bitbucket-assigned UUID of the variable.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import bitbucket_workspace_pipeline_variable.shared_registry {variable-uuid}
```
